title: Ending old forms without hurried assumptions

captions.emotions: Experiencing release of earlier domestic arrangements

meaning: Your domestic support helps an ending when unknown conditions are clarified and readiness to release does not require everything earlier to be abandoned immediately.
text: You may know that an earlier domestic method should end although the new picture has not formed. The Moon in the physical position of Muladhara appears through actions with incomplete information. Death in energy can make an ending unnecessarily abrupt, while Death in emotions experiences release of the outdated. Repetition does not determine the scale of abandonment in advance: feeling one form ending does not prove that everything connected with it has lost its purpose. The unknown needs attention as well as decisiveness.

For example, you stop using an old workspace at home. You want to remove the desk, lamp and all supplies immediately although some activities remain and have nowhere else yet. **Ending a form does not require everything serving it to be declared unnecessary.** Clarifying remaining tasks lets the outdated be released specifically. A transition preserves useful participation without forcing both to continue earlier arrangements or abandon every detail in advance.

The difficulty is treating an object’s temporary retention as inability to part with the past. Decisiveness is measured by quantities removed rather than relief in present life. Support grows when both distinguish an ended need from one still active. A new domestic method can emerge gradually: an acknowledged ending keeps its meaning when unknown conditions receive time and suitable interim support.
